data.body: rebar-debug Phase 2 evidence: public adapter reproduction with 11 blocking findings longer than 240 characters showed the pre-fix mechanism at src/rebar/review_bot/adapter.py:120-122: the message loop silently selected blocking[:10] and silently sliced normalized detail to 240 characters, while the header still claimed 11. This violates the actionable finding contract in CONTRIBUTING.md:129-135 and the ticket acceptance criteria. The final held-out oracle tests the public code_review_decision output at tests/unit/test_review_bot.py:223: with the fix absent it failed RED on the missing ellipsis; after the independent fix it passed GREEN; re-seeding the exact original raw slice/no-overflow branch returned it to RED; restoring the fix returned GREEN. Focused suite: 59 passed, 4 skipped. Original public-adapter scenario now renders 10 bounded bullets, an ellipsis on clipped detail, an exact one-finding overflow disclosure, and retains all 11 full machine-readable findings. Caller sweep found _summarize feeds only the adapter decision message and the voter posts it directly; no caller depends on silent clipping. Bounded sibling sweep of numeric slice caps in review_bot/llm found only hashes, normalization keys, or probes with explicit coverage bounds, not another actionable-feedback truncation. Fix restores truthful review output, adds no dependency, creates no new capability, and weakens no existing test. make check is green; default suite is running.
